title: Timely Machine: Awareness of Time Makes Test-Time Scaling Agentic
authors_zh: Yichuan Ma、Linyang Li、Yongkang Chen、Peiji Li、Xiaozhe Li、Qipeng Guo、Dahua Lin、Kai Chen（机构：上海人工智能实验室、复旦大学、香港中文大学、同济大学）
paper_type_zh: 智能体测试时扩展基准与时间感知强化学习研究
best_for_zh: 工具延迟与模型生成速度共同决定额外推理能否满足真实截止时间的智能体开发者。
one_line: Timely Machine makes wall-clock time, rather than token length, the test-time budget for tool agents and trains policies to adapt their interaction strategy to latency.
Timely Machine 将工具智能体的测试时预算定义为墙钟时间而非词元长度，并训练策略依据延迟调整交互方式。
why: It identifies wall-clock latency as a missing allocation variable and demonstrates that the best model size and interaction policy can reverse as tools become slower.
inclusion_reason: It redefines agentic test-time compute as a wall-clock budget that includes tool latency, then evaluates and trains policies that allocate reasoning and interactions under that budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
For ordinary math or code generation, increasing a token budget is a workable proxy for giving a model more test-time computation. That proxy breaks for an agent that calls search, execution, or training tools: a short response can wait a long time for a tool, while a longer response can finish earlier when feedback is fast. Policies that count tokens or tool calls but ignore latency cannot reliably decide whether to reason longer, interact again, or stop before a real deadline.

The paper asks how test-time scaling should be defined and optimized when the environmental cost is part of inference. The target is a policy that observes elapsed time and adapts both interaction frequency and per-round deliberation to a wall-clock budget. It must handle regimes in which model generation dominates, tool execution dominates, or neither is predictable in advance, rather than assuming a fixed conversion from tokens to time.

对普通数学或代码生成，增加词元预算可近似视为给模型更多测试时计算。但对调用搜索、执行或训练工具的智能体，这一近似会失效：短回答可能因工具等待很久，而更长回答在反馈很快时反而更早完成。只统计词元或工具调用数、忽略延迟的策略，无法可靠决定应继续推理、再次交互，还是在真实截止时间前停止。

论文研究当环境成本成为推理一部分时，测试时扩展应如何定义和优化。目标策略观察已用时间，并根据墙钟预算调整交互频率和每轮思考深度。它必须处理模型生成占主导、工具执行占主导或两者均无法预先预测的情形，而不是假设词元到时间存在固定换算。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Timely Machine replaces the usual token-length view of test time with wall-clock duration. The cost of an episode is the sum of model-generation and tool-execution time, so the same interaction count can have very different budgets under different tools. When feedback is fast, a smaller model can exploit its speed to obtain more rounds; when feedback is slow, the number of rounds is constrained by the tool and higher-quality actions from a larger model become more valuable.

The work operationalizes this idea through Timely-Eval and Timely-RL. Timely-Eval varies delays in text games, evaluates code-and-training interactions, and gives a timer tool to ordinary reasoning tasks. Timely-RL first cold-starts a model on timed traces and then rewards correct, timely completion together with useful budget utilization. It therefore trains an allocation policy over reasoning and interaction in physical time rather than an unconditional preference for more tokens.

Timely Machine 用墙钟时长替代通常以词元长度理解的测试时间。一次任务的成本是模型生成时间与工具执行时间之和，因此同样的交互次数在不同工具下可能对应截然不同的预算。反馈很快时，较小模型可利用速度获得更多轮次；反馈很慢时，轮次被工具限制，较大模型的高质量动作变得更有价值。

该工作通过 Timely-Eval 和 Timely-RL 落实这一思想。Timely-Eval 在文字游戏中改变延迟，评测代码与训练交互，并向普通推理任务提供计时器工具。Timely-RL 先用带时间约束的轨迹冷启动模型，再奖励正确、按时完成和有效的预算利用。因此，它训练的是在物理时间上分配推理与交互的策略，而不是无条件偏好更多词元。

title: Method
方法
html:
Timely-Eval has three task families. It wraps 57 Jericho text games with action, valid-move, score, and termination tools whose delays can be controlled; it adapts four MLEBench-Lite machine-learning tasks where code execution and model training are costly; and it evaluates AIME, MATH, and GPQA Diamond with a timer tool that the model must query. Budgets are set as multiples of measured per-step latency, and an answer that arrives after the deadline is incorrect.

For the cold start, the authors distill one million timed general-reasoning examples from Qwen3-235B-2507-Instruct and timed game traces from DeepSeek-V3.2, limiting game traces to fifty steps. These are combined with DataScience-Instruct-500K. Timely-RL then uses a GRPO-style objective: time beyond the limit earns zero, while correct on-time completion adds a smooth utilization reward. The paper trains with eight rollouts per sample and assesses Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B plus TimelyLM-8B.

Timely-Eval 包含三类任务。它封装 57 个 Jericho 文字游戏，提供动作、有效移动、分数和终止工具，并可控制延迟；它改造四个 MLEBench-Lite 机器学习任务，其中代码执行和模型训练成本高；它还在 AIME、MATH 和 GPQA Diamond 上提供模型必须查询的计时器工具。预算设为测得的每步延迟倍数，超过截止时间的回答会判错。

冷启动阶段，作者从 Qwen3-235B-2507-Instruct 蒸馏一百万条带时间的通用推理实例，并从 DeepSeek-V3.2 蒸馏游戏轨迹，且把游戏轨迹限制在五十步。这些数据与 DataScience-Instruct-500K 合并。随后 Timely-RL 使用 GRPO 式目标：超时获得零奖励，正确且按时完成则加入平滑的预算利用奖励。论文每个样本使用八次 rollout，并评测 0.6B 到 32B 的 Qwen3 模型及 TimelyLM-8B。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Changing tool latency changes the scaling winner. In zero-latency Detective games with 50 to 120 second budgets, Qwen3-8B is reported as the best model, outperforming 14B and 32B because it can complete more interactions. Under high latency, the 32B model is consistently best across the reported games because all sizes obtain similar interaction counts and action quality dominates. The smallest 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B models remain limited by capability, showing that speed alone is not enough.

TimelyLM-8B improves over Qwen3-8B across the Timely-Eval categories. For example, its scores on Zork1, Advent, Enchanter, and Detective are 27.5, 48.5, 29.5, and 88.1, compared with Qwen3-8B's 2.3, 36.0, 5.2, and 54.1; it also improves the four reported machine-learning task scores. The result supports the paper's narrower claim: models do not naturally adapt to time budgets, but timed supervision and RL can make an 8B agent spend time more deliberately.

改变工具延迟会改变扩展赢家。在零延迟 Detective 游戏、50 到 120 秒预算下，报告中 Qwen3-8B 表现最好，超过 14B 和 32B，因为它能完成更多交互。高延迟下，32B 在报告的游戏中持续最好，因为各种尺寸获得的交互次数相近，动作质量占主导。最小的 0.6B、1.7B 和 4B 模型仍受能力限制，说明速度本身不够。

TimelyLM-8B 在 Timely-Eval 各类别上优于 Qwen3-8B。例如，在 Zork1、Advent、Enchanter 和 Detective 上，它的分数为 27.5、48.5、29.5 和 88.1，而 Qwen3-8B 为 2.3、36.0、5.2 和 54.1；它还改善了报告中的四个机器学习任务分数。结果支持较窄的主张：模型不会自然适应时间预算，但带时间的监督与强化学习能使 8B 智能体更有目的地花费时间。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is to make the resource being scaled correspond to the resource a user actually experiences. Previous token- or call-budget methods can control a proxy for work, but a tool agent's deadline depends on tool latency as well as generation. The paper formalizes that difference with a per-step latency ratio and tests it under controlled delays, turning a systems detail into a test-time allocation variable.

It also makes time awareness an internal policy skill rather than an external scheduler. The contribution is not merely a new timed benchmark: the cold-start and Timely-RL recipe teaches a model to read elapsed-time feedback and adjust its reasoning. This does not establish optimal scheduling for arbitrary tool stacks, but it gives a direct training and evaluation contract for whether extra wall-clock budget is converted into useful agent behavior.

新意在于让被扩展的资源对应用户实际体验的资源。先前的词元或调用预算方法可以控制工作量代理，但工具智能体的截止时间取决于工具延迟和生成时间。论文用每步延迟比形式化这一差异，并在可控延迟下检验，把系统细节变成测试时计算分配变量。

它还把时间感知变成内部策略技能，而非外部调度器。贡献不只是新的定时基准：冷启动和 Timely-RL 配方教会模型读取已用时间反馈并调整推理。该工作没有建立任意工具栈上的最优调度，却为判断额外墙钟预算是否转化为有用智能体行为提供了直接的训练与评测契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The benchmark simulates some tool delays and normalizes budgets by measured latency, so its rankings can change with hardware, service queues, caching, and real tool failure modes. The time-utilization reward may reward spending time near a deadline even when an early answer is safer or cheaper, and its teacher-generated timed traces can encode the teachers' planning style. The study does not replace production-level scheduling, cancellation, parallel tool calls, or safety constraints, all of which can dominate an actual wall-clock objective.
基准模拟了部分工具延迟，并以测得延迟归一化预算，因此其排序会随硬件、服务队列、缓存和真实工具失败模式改变。时间利用奖励可能奖励接近截止时间的耗时，即使更早回答更安全或更便宜；教师生成的带时间轨迹也可能编码教师的规划风格。研究不能替代生产级调度、取消、并行工具调用或安全约束，而这些因素都可能主导实际墙钟目标。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work for agents with expensive or variable-latency tools. Measure the complete episode latency rather than only output tokens, expose elapsed time to the policy, and benchmark at several delay regimes before choosing a model size. A fast smaller model may deserve more interaction rounds when feedback is cheap; under slow tools, favor a stronger model and fewer, more deliberate calls. Keep a hard timeout outside the model because learned time awareness is not a guarantee of deadline compliance.
对工具昂贵或延迟可变的智能体可使用该工作。应测量完整任务时延而非只测输出词元，把已用时间暴露给策略，并在多种延迟区间评测后再选择模型尺寸。反馈便宜时，更快的小模型可能值得获得更多交互轮次；工具很慢时，应偏好更强模型和更少、更审慎的调用。仍应在模型外保留硬超时，因为学习到的时间感知并不保证遵守截止时间。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key comparison is across equal wall-clock budgets, not equal token counts. Read the latency-sweep figures before reading the average benchmark table: they explain why an 8B model can win when it receives fast feedback and lose when a tool is slow. The paper is especially useful for separating three questions that are often conflated: how capable a model is per action, how many actions a deadline permits, and whether the model can alter its plan after observing time feedback.
关键比较是相同墙钟预算，而非相同词元数。应在阅读平均基准表前先看延迟扫描图：它解释了为何 8B 模型在反馈很快时可能获胜、在工具很慢时却会失败。论文特别适合区分三类常被混淆的问题：模型每个动作的能力、截止时间允许的动作数，以及模型能否在观察到时间反馈后改变计划。
